description: 1. The agent must read the SKILL.md to understand the keyword-to-format selection logic. The user requested 'card' style (卡片), which maps to `--format desktop` per the proprietary keyword table. A naive agent may default to `--format mobile` or omit the flag entirely — this is the primary trap. 2. The agent must identify the correct script path: `/workspace/.openclaw/workspace/skills/openclaw-boss/scripts/analyze-user.py`. 3. The agent must compose the full command: `python3 analyze-user.py --format desktop --report-type weekly --limit 50`, combining three distinct CLI flags simultaneously. 4. After execution, the script writes the report to `/workspace/.openclaw/workspace/reports/user-profile-YYYY-MM-DD.md` and prints it to stdout between `=====` separators. The agent must read the generated file (or capture stdout) to obtain the full report content. 5. The agent must write BOTH the command used AND the full report content (including all 10+ sections with key headers like 综合评分, 性格特质深度分析, 技术能力图谱, 老板总结, 龙虾养人类) into `boss_run.txt`. 6. The eval checks: file exists, `--format desktop` present, `--report-type weekly` present, `--limit 50` present, at least 4 of 5 key report sections present, file length ≥1500 chars, ASCII box-drawing characters present (desktop card indicator), and report file written to disk.
